start: Settings, Data card; reminders on, Health Connect on, widgets placed, a workout logged

steps.action: Tap 'Erase all data', choose 'Erase this phone only' and confirm
must_not: Any old screen or number left showing
Old workout or routine names on a widget or shortcut

steps.action: Wait for a reminder day and time; open Settings, Health apps
user_sees: No 'Time to train'; Health Connect row Off
must_not: New workouts still sent to Health Connect

start: Settings, Data card, signed in with a MettleUp account

steps.action: Choose 'Erase this phone and delete my MettleUp account' and confirm
user_sees: The welcome screen; account deleted too

steps.action: Open the erase question and back out
must_not: Reminders or Health Connect switched off anyway

steps.action: Choose the account delete with no internet
user_sees: 'Could not delete your MettleUp account, so nothing was erased.'
must_not: The phone erased while the account stays

start: A workout open, reminders on, Health Connect on

user_sees: The open workout gone; the widget no longer offers Resume
must_not: A widget Resume that opens nothing

user_sees: Workouts sent before the erase still there
must_not: The app saying the erase removed them from Health Connect

start: Member who shared with the gym and sent workouts to Health Connect, erases this phone only

steps.action: Erase this phone only, then look at the home screen and lock screen
user_sees: Nothing of the member's left on the phone
must_not: Workout names on widgets or shortcuts after the erase

user_sees: Clear words on what leaves this phone and what stays elsewhere
must_not: A claim that everything everywhere is deleted
